title: formalize the BrainCli interface
description:
## .what

formalize a `BrainCli` interface in rhachet: the contract a brain supplier implements so rhachet can spawn, drive, and read a brain cli (tui and `-p` print modes) with no knowledge of which cli it is.

## .why

rhachet proves real claude cli behaviors in its own acceptance tier (`blackbox/cli/clone.*.realbrain`, `brain-dir-boot.journey`, `enroll.shared-brain-auth`). each run spends api credit, and each unrelated rhachet change retests a real claude. those behaviors belong to the anthropic supplier. a formal `BrainCli` interface is the seam that lets the supplier prove them, and lets rhachet test its own side against a mock cli.

## .scope

- declare the interface in rhachet: spawn (tui, print), input dispatch, screen and transcript read, the memory-file layout it loads, auth state
- rhachet suites that drive a clone exercise the interface via a mock cli
- no supplier change here; that is the follow-up task in `ehmpathy/rhachet-brains-anthropic`, which waits on this one

## .source
